body:
Release v1.5.3 published.

Release page: https://github.com/C5Lab/M5MonsterC5-Tab5/releases/tag/v1.5.3
Web flasher: https://C5Lab.github.io/M5MonsterC5-Tab5/
Firmware (1.5.3): https://github.com/C5Lab/M5MonsterC5-Tab5/releases/download/v1.5.3/M5MonsterC5-Tab5-1.5.3.zip
Bundle: https://github.com/C5Lab/M5MonsterC5-Tab5/releases/download/v1.5.3/M5MonsterC5-Tab5-1.5.3-bundle.zip

1.5.3

Summary
M5Monster Tab5 1.5.3 release with ESPShark offline PCAP analysis, centralized capture management, new GITM workflows, and improved Wardrive reliability.
Key changes
- Added centralized Monster capture management:
  - transfers captures from JanOS to the Tab5 SD card,
  - supports JanOS Admin Wi-Fi and M-BUS UART transfers,
  - validates file size, free space, and CRC32 before finalizing downloads,
  - supports batch synchronization of new PCAP and handshake files.
- Added the ESPShark offline investigation workspace:
  - provides a local PCAP viewer with protocol filters and packet details,
  - adds TCP/UDP flow analysis and Follow Stream Lite,
  - separates local devices from remote endpoints,
  - adds interactive DNS, FQDN resolution, topology maps, and host quick views,
  - detects exposed services, cleartext credentials, encrypted DNS, and other security findings,
  - supports IOC matching, known-good baselines, JSON/HTML reports, and filtered PCAP exports,
  - extracts HTTP objects from captures,
  - generates deterministic English capture summaries.
- Improved Network Observer reliability:
  - prevents the handshaker from attacking unintended networks,
  - rescans and synchronizes the selected target before starting an attack,
  - preserves network security information and reuses saved MITM credentials,
  - fixes popup readiness and target-selection race conditions.
- Added the JanOS Capture Gateway interface:
  - provides a full-screen live GITM session view,
  - displays connected clients, captured credentials, warnings, and session statistics,
  - stops active sniffing correctly when leaving the page,
  - moves board detection outside the UI thread to prevent interface freezes.
- Added Rogue GITM:
  - deauthenticates the selected victim,
  - mirrors the target SSID,
  - routes traffic through a same-channel uplink,
  - reuses the Capture Gateway live monitoring and capture workflow.
- Added audio alerts for client joins, credential captures, warnings, and followed targets.
- Improved Wardrive file management:
  - detects and reports incomplete file listings,
  - displays listing progress and file counts,
  - supports selecting and deleting multiple files,
  - safely quotes file paths and maps deletion results,
  - prevents overlapping monitor tasks after rapid stop/start actions.
- Improved multi-board SD-card detection with repeated probes and automatic status refresh after board detection.
- Added comprehensive ESPShark, MITM, GITM, and Capture Gateway documentation.
- Added host-side tests for Capture Gateway parsing, audio generation, summary reducers, and deterministic reports.
Artifacts
- Updated M5MonsterC5-Tab5.bin, M5MonsterC5-Tab5-full.bin, and bootloader.bin.
- Added reusable PCAP reader, flow analysis, investigation, extraction, summary, and analysis-cache components.
- Added illustrated ARP MITM and Rogue GITM documentation.
